findings: Preparation binds all 21 complete new shards and three complete pilot producers, their exact scopes/drivers/receipts, authenticated map and normalization declarations, and the completed pilot QA. The union has exactly one map for every original ON scan and each of 766 supported native/q cores.

Execution authenticates whole map and normalization byte hashes before loading saved NPZ fields. It verifies original frequency coordinates, drift grid, window/width indices and valid counts. It performs no preprocessing or window/drift search.

Each original ON scan has separate unrestricted and DC-clean heaps. New maps use stored per-hypothesis clean maxima; the untouched pilot uses raw fields for both families, supported by its prospective all-hypothesis DC-clean geometry and prior numerical QA.

Clean EMPTY records must occur only at the three frozen DC reference channels per ON scan, with -inf/NaN/-1/0 sentinels. Finite clean maxima cannot exceed raw maxima and all winning clean boxes must avoid DC. The complete union counts 9,412,608 raw and 9,412,599 nonempty clean carrier winners.

Global ordering is score descending then integer reference channel ascending. Map reference domains are disjoint, so each score/channel key is unique within a scan and heap tie handling does not compare dictionaries.

Keeping the first 700 candidates per map cannot omit a global top700 record: any excluded record already has 700 better records in its own map. The fixed-size heap therefore recovers exact global top700 for each scan and family.

Greedy spacing suppresses integer reference channels within three inclusive. Each selected channel can account for at most seven candidate channels; after 99 selections at most 693 can be accounted for. Therefore the 100th selection must appear by raw rank694, and top700 is sufficient. This is an ordering/completeness bound, not statistical independence.

All six family/scan combinations retain rawTOP700, spacedTOP100 and TOP3 in JSON plus CSV. CSV cells encode exact compact JSON values and preserve typed round trips. All map maxima/counts and selected cleanTOP9 are retained with producer provenance.

Winning-window reference epochs, original drifts/widths, source headers and static normalization cores are unchanged. Reference-bin spacing across different winning-window epochs remains a descriptive rule and does not identify physical sources.

Exact prepared scope and root GO, create-only output, resource caps and post-run input/hash checks guard execution. No shard shortlist, refit, sky qualification or pooled HIP98505 ranking is introduced.
orchestration_requirements: The main full dual-map numerical QA must PASS before these ranks are used scientifically. Aggregate preparation directly checks pilot PASS; bind the full QA receipt in extra metadata pins/root admission and enforce its PASS in the root workflow.
Run the separately frozen independent complete-carrier full-sort QA after aggregation. It must match all top700/spaced100/TOP3 JSON/CSV records and nine EMPTY identities before preparing context.
Only then freeze context selections, keeping primary four-row DC-clean eligibility distinct from transported four-row/full16 context DC contact diagnostics.
limits: This is exact ranking of exposed cached maxima within one historical visit, not independent validation of every original raw grid, calibrated SNR/FAP, a sky-origin statement or qualified SETI detection. The two outer reference cores remain excluded.
